audit_items.proof_trace: The rolling-window rate limiter is correctly enforced for all user-facing outflow paths. `add_outflow` calls `count_current_outflow` to compute the sum of all segments within `[timestamp_index - len + 1, timestamp_index]` and asserts the accumulated total plus the new value does not exceed `outflow_limit` before writing; `handle_withdraw` invokes `deposit_limiter.add_outflow` (market.move:349) and `handle_borrow` invokes `borrow_limiter.add_outflow` (market.move:402). The `// NOTE: disable rate limit` comment at liquidation_inner:745 is an explicit design decision — liquidations bypass the limiter for protocol-solvency reasons, and flash loans are covered by the hot-potato repayment invariant ensuring same-transaction settlement.
